entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had been invited to Cavette, the..."
entries.dialogueText: I had been invited to Cavette, the capital of Morella, for a meeting with Prime Minister Alma Saltana.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Welcome back to Morella, {RiziaDLC..."
entries.dialogueText: "Welcome back to Morella, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's good to see you again, Madam..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's good to see you again, Madam Prime Minister."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Quite a lovely park you have here.""
entries.dialogueText: "Quite a lovely park you have here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't have all day. Let's get do..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't have all day. Let's get down to it, shall we?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""In good time.""
entries.dialogueText: "In good time."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled and motioned for me to f..."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled and motioned for me to follow her.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I like it too.""
entries.dialogueText: "I like it too."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""The Moridian emperors found beauty..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Moridian emperors found beauty in control. Today, we find it in freedom."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""We didn't part under the best of c..."
entries.dialogueText: "We didn't part under the best of circumstances last time."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""But everyone deserves a second cha..."
entries.dialogueText: "But everyone deserves a second chance. That's my philosophy, at least."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She motioned for me to follow her."
entries.dialogueText: She motioned for me to follow her.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A barely marked path led into a den..."
entries.dialogueText: A barely marked path led into a dense bamboo grove. We walked in, shadowed by our guards.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""This was all planted after the Val..."
entries.dialogueText: "This was all planted after the Valgs left. Amazing how fast it grows."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On it was a square-jawed man -- Axe..."
entries.dialogueText: On it was a square-jawed man -- Axel Reinhart's exact double -- triumphantly hoisting his sword atop the park's central hill.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "An inscription below it read: "In C..."
entries.dialogueText: An inscription below it read: "In Commemoration of the Brave Deeds of Otto Reinhart, Viceroy of Pales and Loyal Servant of the Valgos Empire."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm surprised you haven't gotten r..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm surprised you haven't gotten rid of this. Why keep around reminders of the Valgos occupation?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Valgos Empire used our family'..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Valgos Empire used our family's conflict as an excuse for a land grab. Both of our countries lost territory."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At the end of the path, we came to..."
entries.dialogueText: At the end of the path, we came to a small cylindrical building that looked strikingly different from anything else in the park.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""A traditional Morellan teahouse. H..."
entries.dialogueText: "A traditional Morellan teahouse. Historically, a place for exchange and a refuge from prying eyes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We had a seat inside as our guards..."
entries.dialogueText: We had a seat inside as our guards kept watch outdoors.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The low-ceilinged room was decorate..."
entries.dialogueText: The low-ceilinged room was decorated wall-to-wall in colorful woven fabrics. In its center, smoke rose from a roaring fire pit up through a hole in the middle of the ceiling.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A waiter came by with a tray of suk..."
entries.dialogueText: A waiter came by with a tray of sukhar, Morellan tea biscuits.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why, thank you. I'd love a biscuit.""
entries.dialogueText: "Why, thank you. I'd love a biscuit."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They look delicious, but I ate bef..."
entries.dialogueText: "They look delicious, but I ate before I came here."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""This is Morellan tea culture, {Riz..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is Morellan tea culture, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}. It's impolite to refuse an offer of food."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All right. In that case, just one.""
entries.dialogueText: "All right. In that case, just one."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The waiter placed a pair of intrica..."
entries.dialogueText: The waiter placed a pair of intricately ornamented tea glasses in front of us and filled them up.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We each took a biscuit off the tray..."
entries.dialogueText: We each took a biscuit off the tray.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The waiter, however, seemed to have..."
entries.dialogueText: The waiter, however, seemed to have disappeared without serving us anything to drink.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Hmm, that's an oversight. Well, I'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hmm, that's an oversight. Well, I'm sure he'll be over with our tea shortly."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I noticed Saltana had left her bisc..."
entries.dialogueText: I noticed Saltana had left her biscuit uneaten.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""In the meantime...""
entries.dialogueText: "In the meantime..."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I admit that before the nationaliz..."
entries.dialogueText: "I admit that before the nationalization vote, I had held out hope that your kingdom would recognize its debt to Morella and agree to our plan."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I was disappointed when that turne..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was disappointed when that turned out not to be the case."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we kept walking, I noticed the c..."
entries.dialogueText: As we kept walking, I noticed the corner of a wooden object peeking out from behind the stalks.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I ignored it and kept following Pri..."
entries.dialogueText: I ignored it and kept following Prime Minister Saltana.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I stopped and pushed the stalks asi..."
entries.dialogueText: I stopped and pushed the stalks aside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It appeared to be a memorial plaque..."
entries.dialogueText: It appeared to be a memorial plaque, carved in traditional Valgish style.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Like it or not, it was part of our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Like it or not, it was part of our history."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Morella went up against House Tora..."
entries.dialogueText: "Morella went up against House Toras. What did you think would happen?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""The taking of Cavette. Our punishm..."
entries.dialogueText: "The taking of Cavette. Our punishment for siding with the wrong house in your War of Succession."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What a tragedy. Our houses should'..."
entries.dialogueText: "What a tragedy. Our houses should've found a peaceful compromise instead of dragging other countries into battle."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""It was the Empire of Moridia that..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was the Empire of Moridia that got involved. If I had been in charge back then, I would have had the good sense to stay out of it entirely."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""We lost one of our most important..."
entries.dialogueText: "We lost one of our most important cities and our access to the Antacean. There is no comparison."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I agree, with the caveat that Mori..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree, with the caveat that Moridia wasn't dragged. They saw their alliance with the Azaro family as a way to gain power over Rizia."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Losing territory to Valgsland was..."
entries.dialogueText: "Losing territory to Valgsland was fair enough punishment."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""At least we were able to take back..."
entries.dialogueText: "At least we were able to take back the territory we lost."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ffffrmmhhhhfhmph.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ffffrmmhhhhfhmph."
entries.menuText: "You're shit out of luck, lady. Rizia isn't budging either."

entries.dialogueText: "Ffffrmmhhhhfhmph."

entries.dialogueText: "Ffffrmmhhhhfhmph."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana

entries.dialogueText: "Believe me, there is no love lost between Morella and the Reinharts. But we're happy to let them keep their little piece of land. As long as they stay there."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Can a nation 'belong' to anyone?""
entries.dialogueText: "Can a nation 'belong' to anyone?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""When Lespia started sending Pales..."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana

entries.dialogueText: "Cavette and the coast were relatively new additions to the Grand Duchy."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""There were still plenty of Morella..."
entries.dialogueText: "There were still plenty of Morellans living there, ready to rise up and take their land back."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Impressive. I'd love to learn more..."
entries.dialogueText: "Impressive. I'd love to learn more about those planes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Did you ever feel tempted to take..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did you ever feel tempted to take over *all* of Pales?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Even if we had the might to do so,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if we had the might to do so, we couldn't have done it without making enemies of Rizia. Or am I wrong?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We drank. The tea was delicious."
entries.dialogueText: We drank. The tea was delicious.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana leaned forward."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana leaned forward.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Neither of us want to resort to mi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Neither of us want to resort to military measures. But I will say this."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Both Valgsland and Morella have ke..."
entries.dialogueText: "Both Valgsland and Morella have kept a close eye on the Rizian populace. Particularly your youth."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I believe there's a certain... spi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe there's a certain... spirit in your country. One that, if given the proper support and channels, could bring about monumental change."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mrrrrphourghhh.""
entries.dialogueText: "Mrrrrphourghhh."
entries.menuText: "You're keeping an eye on our youth? That's disturbing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mrrrrphourghhh?""
entries.dialogueText: "Mrrrrphourghhh?"
entries.menuText: "Is that a threat, Ms. Saltana? You'll spark a revolution in Rizia if you don't get what you want?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mrrrrphourghhh!""
entries.dialogueText: "Mrrrrphourghhh!"
entries.menuText: "I don't care. Just bring me some tea, dammit!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I didn't say anything."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't say anything.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""If you're willing to agree on an I..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you're willing to agree on an ITZ proposal that is fair and equitable towards Morella, you won't have to find out whether I'm right."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gave a tiny nod. Our waiter ste..."
entries.dialogueText: She gave a tiny nod. Our waiter stepped over with a pot of tea and two intricately ornamented ceramic cups.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That was a nasty stunt.""
entries.dialogueText: "That was a nasty stunt."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Phew. That biscuit was drier than the last AN session."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If that was an attempt to intimida..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that was an attempt to intimidate me, you have failed."

entries.dialogueText: "I am truly sorry. I have no idea what took our waiter so long."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is that a threat, Ms. Saltana? You..."

entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for agreeing."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The majority speaker is well conne..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Normally, they are more of a hindr..."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I'm sure she knows all about their..."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""So you admit your legislative body..."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Regardless of your... parliament's..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "You will not insult my country's most prominent businessman."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have little sympathy for the CEO..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have little sympathy for the CEO of Rizian Royal Gold. But in this case, he was right."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We both know it's more complicated..."
entries.dialogueText: "We both know it's more complicated than that. A sizeable portion of Rizia's economy relies on RRG."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I am not beholden to Rizian Royal..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am not beholden to Rizian Royal Gold in any way. I stand by what I said."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""The mortality risk of miners worki..."
entries.dialogueText: "The mortality risk of miners working in the Trade Zone is twice as high as that of regular Morellans. The boost to our countries' economies is not worth human lives."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "To be fair, every job comes with risks. I could be beheaded at any time."

entries.dialogueText: "Still, we'd be losing quite a bit of money. It'll be hard to justify that to my government."

entries.dialogueText: "The mortality risk of miners working in the Trade Zone is twice as high as that of regular Morellans. The boost to our countries' economies is not worth human lives."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana

entries.dialogueText: "What if we shrank Rizia's share in the new agreement? Morella would have majority control of the MITZ, and you could implement as much oversight as you wanted."

entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana looked puzzled."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana looked puzzled.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Of course that would be wonderful...."
